result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Create a signed license key

USAGE:
    xrm-license create [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
        --licensee <NAME>             Name of the licensee (required)           
        --features <FEATURES>         Comma-separated list of feature keys      
                                      (required)                                
        --expires <DATE>              Expiry date (e.g. 2026-06-01). Omit for   
                                      perpetual license                         
        --private-key <PATH>          Path to private key file (default:        
                                      ./private.key)                            
        --private-key-base64 <KEY>    Base64-encoded private key (alternative to
                                      --private-key file)                       
        --output <FILE>               Output .lic file path (optional, also     
                                      prints to stdout)
